lines.text: Mia pulled her face cover up at the trailhead and kept it there the whole climb.
On the windy ridge, it froze stiff against her chin.
On the climb, push the face panel down and let your face breathe.
When the wind hits, pull it up over your nose and snug the hood.
Mia reached the top with a warm, dry face.
Save this before your next cold hike.
